input.name: Look up member accounts and count
input.description: Signs in to Corevance Core Banking Admin, looks up a member by ID, and returns the member's list of accounts (one row per account) from which the number of accounts held can be determined.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Numeric member identifier to look up

outputs.name: accounts_listing
outputs.description: Tab/newline separated text: header row (Account Number, Type, Opened, Balance) followed by one data row per account the member holds. The number of accounts equals the number of data rows (total lines minus the header line).

steps.intent: Enter the member ID to search for

business_outcomes.message: No member record exists for the given member ID.

steps.intent: Read the member's accounts table to determine how many accounts they hold

locator.description: Accounts table (innermost table, no nested tables)

business_outcomes.message: The member record exists but has no accounts listed.
